authorization: User delegated automatic label review, policy locking and training in this chat.
experience_policy: Only explicit source units; retain bounds/kind. Missing values have indicators and no numeric feature; never infer years from seniority or bare source numbers.
outlier_policy: Retain all verified positive finite labels, including high salaries. No target-dependent clipping, winsorization, log transform or post-test exclusions.
selection: Lowest unrounded validation MAE; exact tie chooses LinearRegression.
release: Chosen model MAE must beat train-median baseline on both validation and test; no model switching or tuning after test.
scope: Exploratory coursework run, not a statistically representative salary estimate. Small holdouts reported explicitly. No accuracy guarantee.
data_gate: Open only for the reviewed checksum-pinned source and this single cohort; existing YODY and other cohorts stay separate.
